title: agents-md-compiler bundle manifest, schema version 1
description: Structure of a decoded manifest. The manifest itself is TOML; validate this schema against the decoded mapping. Filesystem, byte-level, and uniqueness rules cannot be expressed here and are enforced by the compiler, which is the authority.

bundle_id.description: Bundle identifier, interpolated into generated ASCII markers.

default_target.description: Default install target. Resolved against the manifest directory. A leading tilde expands; nothing else does.

modules.description: Ordered, mandatory module list. Manifest order is output order.

id.description: Module identifier, unique within the bundle.

source.description: Path to one canonical Markdown source. Absolute, manifest-relative, or tilde-relative.
